title: Gia cố securityContext cấp Container chống leo thang đặc quyền
code:
securityContext:
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  capabilities:
    drop:
      - ALL

title: Gắn nhãn Pod Security Admission mức restricted cho Namespace
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: payments
  labels:
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted
